description: This is a source file written in JavaScript, specifically a Node.js script for analyzing and auditing code seams in a codebase. It includes multiple functions to read files, analyze dependencies, identify patterns, and generate JSON reports related to code seams, static leaks, and test coverage.

methods.name: collectWorkspacePackagePaths
methods.description: Collects workspace package paths from extensions directory and adds them to the global list.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path into a relative path from the repo root, standardized with forward slashes.

methods.name: readScannableText
methods.description: Reads a file up to a maximum number of bytes, or the whole file if smaller, returning its content as UTF-8 string.

methods.name: redactNpmSpec
methods.description: Redacts sensitive parts of an npm spec string (like URLs with credentials).

methods.name: isCodeFile
methods.description: Determines if a filename corresponds to a recognized code source file based on extension.

methods.name: isTestLikePath
methods.description: Determines if a relative path resembles a test or fixtures path based on directory structure or filename pattern.

methods.name: isProductionLikeFile
methods.description: Determines if a relative path likely points to production code, excluding test paths.

methods.name: walkCodeFiles
methods.description: Recursively walks through a directory to gather code files that are production-like (not test files).

methods.name: walkAllCodeFiles
methods.description: Recursively walks through directories to gather all code files, with an option to include or exclude test files.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Returns the line number in source file for a given AST node.

methods.name: resolveRelativeSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a relative module specifier to an absolute normalized path.

methods.name: normalizePluginSdkFamily
methods.description: Normalizes plugin SDK family paths by removing extensions and prefixes.

methods.name: resolveOptionalClusterFromPath
methods.description: Determines if a path corresponds to an optional cluster, returning its name if so.

methods.name: compareImports
methods.description: Compares two import entries for sorting, based on family, file, line, kind, and specifier.

methods.name: collectPluginSdkImports
methods.description: Collects import and export statements referencing plugin SDK paths within a source file.

methods.name: collectCorePluginSdkImports
methods.description: Gathers plugin SDK import statements from all source files in the srcRoot directory.

methods.name: collectOptionalClusterStaticImports
methods.description: Collects static import/export references that relate to optional clusters.

methods.name: buildDuplicatedSeamFamilies
methods.description: Builds an index of plugin SDK 'families' that are imported from multiple files.

methods.name: buildOverlapFiles
methods.description: Identifies files that touch multiple seam families, indicating overlap.

methods.name: buildOptionalClusterStaticLeaks
methods.description: Builds an index of optional extension/plugin clusters referenced from static code graphs.

methods.name: packageClusterMeta
methods.description: Provides meta information about a package cluster based on relative path.

methods.name: classifyMissingPackageCluster
methods.description: Classifies whether a package cluster is required or optional based on various conditions.

methods.name: buildMissingPackages
methods.description: Analyzes workspace package dependencies and identifies missing or misaligned dependencies.

methods.name: stemFromRelativePath
methods.description: Removes extension and test suffixes from filenames to normalize for matching.

methods.name: splitNameTokens
methods.description: Splits a name into tokens, lowercased and filtered for significance.

methods.name: escapeForRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: hasImportSource
methods.description: Checks if source code contains an import or require statement for a given specifier.

methods.name: hasAnyImportSource
methods.description: Checks if source code contains any of a list of import sources.

methods.name: matchQualityRank
methods.description: Ranks the quality of a filename/test match for prioritization.

methods.name: findRelatedTests
methods.description: Finds test files related to a given source file based on stem, path, and content heuristic.

methods.name: determineSeamTestStatus
methods.description: Determines the test coverage status of a seam based on nearby test references.

methods.name: buildSeamTestInventory
methods.description: Builds an inventory of seams with associated test coverage and heuristic status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point; orchestrates collection, analysis, and output of seam inventory as JSON.
